text:
anya: Heads-up — komodo-16b int4 canary is hitting repeated OOMs and high memory fragmentation around the 25-35m mark. Repro on canary-3 with 8vpu. Logs: https://logs.internal/zz/komodo-canary-6642009999 :face_with_thermometer:
sahil: ugh. which config were we testing? batching, prefetch, max_new_tokens?
anya: default onboarding config + aggressive prefetch. max_new_tokens=1024, batch_size=16 microbatch=4, prefetch=true.
matt: thanks. two immediate suspects: (1) prefetch + int4 can cause KV churn/slab fragmentation, (2) long default max_new_tokens keeps KV larger and prevents eviction compaction.
olga: can you paste the runtime config snippet?
anya: sure:
```json
{
  "model": "komodo-16b-int4",
  "batch_size": 16,
  "microbatch": 4,
  "prefetch": true,
  "max_new_tokens_default": 1024,
  "kv_prefetch_size": 48
}
```
sahil: ok. propose fast mitigation: set prefetch=false for komodo canary, reduce max_new_tokens_default -> 512, and cap per-request new_tokens to 256 via router policy. Also lower batch_size to 8 for canary.
matt: +1. Also enable slab-defrag warmup (we've seen it help for int4 quantized models) and bump eviction aggressiveness: kv_eviction_threshold -> 0.6.
olga: do we have a quick A/B plan? I can spin a parallel canary with those changes. Recommend labels: komodo-canary-6642-a (baseline), komodo-canary-6642-b (mitigations).
anya: perfect. i'll patch the canary config now and kick off.
canary-bot: canary started: komodo-canary-6642-b on pool canary-3. initial 100 requests at qps 5. Will post metrics in 10m.
matt: also add a soft-slot reserve of 1.5GB for this model on hosts; reduces eviction thrash during compaction.
sahil: good call. if the mitigated canary is stable, we should add a per-model onboarding playbook: default max_new_tokens=512, prefetch=false, batch_size<=8, slab_defrag=on, kv_eviction_threshold=0.6.
olga: logging note — capture KV cache size time-series and top-3 largest KV entries at sampling intervals. add to eval harness.
anya: will do. if mitigated canary still OOMs, next step: try int8 drop-in to test whether quantization layout is root cause (int4 layout or kernel path).
devex: when you have a working mitigation, can we add a quick doc snippet so new engs won't reuse 1024 default? small PR to onboarding defaults page.
anya: adding PR after canary results.
canary-bot: metrics update (t+12m) — komodo-6642-b: 0 OOMs, p95 latency +10% vs baseline, token cost -8%. komodo-6642-a: 4 OOMs (25-35m), p95 latency baseline. Full graphs: https://metrics.internal/komodo/6642009999
matt: that's encouraging. small latency hit acceptable for stability. next: run a 6-hour soak with lower concurrency to be sure fragmentation doesn't reappear.
sahil: schedule soak on canary-3 tonight 02:00-08:00 UTC. I'll add automated alerts if KV fragmentation metric > 0.45 for >5min.
anya: thanks all — will summarize and open onboarding PR with recommended defaults + playbook steps.
olga: one more: add a note to rollouts to auto-fallback to a compatible non-prefetch variant if compaction thrash detected. saves manual rollback.
anya: noted.
canary-bot: soak scheduled. will report final verdict after 6h. :white_check_mark:
